_note: Commission rates and fare rules. FeeCalculator and RidePricing read these at boot; they are the only place a rate is defined.

_pricingPolicy.ride: Customer pays providerFare + platformFee. Provider keeps the whole fare. platformFee = min(maximumFee, max(minimumFee, distanceKm * perKm)).
_pricingPolicy.pasuyo: UNRESOLVED: still priced by the legacy percentage commission below. Not changed in this sprint.
_pricingPolicy.rental: UNRESOLVED: still priced by the legacy percentage commission below. Not changed in this sprint.

platformFee._note: Centavos. perKmCentavos 200 = PHP 2.00/km; minCentavos 500 = PHP 5.00; maxCentavos 3000 = PHP 30.00. These configure the ride platform fee only; providerFare is the agreed fare and is paid to the provider in full.
